## Natural history notes

A semi-aquatic rodent characterized by its dense brown fur, small rounded ears, partially webbed hind feet, and round, sparsely haired tail. In Florida, it is found in freshwater marshes, wet prairies, ponds, and lake edges with dense emergent vegetation. It feeds mainly on grasses, sedges, and aquatic plants, often building small dome-shaped houses or feeding platforms from surrounding marsh vegetation.
